svg.title: Tab height and the final depth pass
svg.desc: A side-view schematic: top Z zero, first pass minus 0.5, second pass and tab top minus 1, final cut minus 1.5 millimetres. The final path lifts across the tab. Earlier passes must not already cut below its intended top.

g.text: Tab Z is an absolute coordinate — side view, schematic
Blue: final-pass tool path. Earlier passes reach the tab top, not below it.
